description: Create any-density baseline gate script that counts `: any` occurrences and prevents regression
steps: Create `scripts/check-any-density.mjs` that: (1) scans all .ts files under configured directories (apps/ajun-runtime/src, apps/ajun-runtime/frontend/src, other workspaces), (2) counts `: any` occurrences per directory, (3) compares to baseline JSON, (4) fails if density increases

Create `any-density-baseline.json` at repo root with current counts: apps/ajun-runtime/src: ~10616, apps/ajun-runtime/frontend/src: ~1002. Use per-directory structure so it can track multiple workspaces.
Add `check:any-density` script to root package.json: `node scripts/check-any-density.mjs`
Add the check:any-density step to the CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml)
Write a test for the script in scripts/check-any-density.test.mjs using node:test
acceptance_criteria: Running `node scripts/check-any-density.mjs` passes against current codebase (baseline matches)
If a new `: any` is added, the script would fail (verify by explaining the logic)
Baseline JSON has schemaVersion and per-directory counts
Script is referenced in CI workflow
verification: node scripts/check-any-density.mjs (should exit 0 with current codebase)
findings: Counting uses per-line matching (one match per line max) with /:\s*any\b/ which gives 10616 for apps/ajun-runtime/src and 1002 for apps/ajun-runtime/frontend/src. The CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) already had the check:any-density step defined. Pre-existing issue: npm run check fails due to repository-catalog.json area validation (unrelated to this feature).
